records.section: DomiGo v2 — Grade 1 (as-built) / 3. The game: "The Lost Pages" / Premise
records.requirementOrFinding: `g1.st.lost-pages` (`story@1`, title *The Lost Pages / Die verlorenen Seiten*). A magic storybook is **fading** — its pages have gone empty and the words are lost. **Finn**, a small paper-and-ink sprite who lives in the book, is your guide. Each unit is one **empty page**; you and Finn walk into the room, **find the lost words** (vocab), **fix the sentence** (grammar), and **recap what happened** (comprehension) to restore the page. Finn's arc closes in unit 15: with the book whole, he *leaves the book to meet you at school* — handing the reader back to the real classroom. It is deliberately gentle and cosy (age 6–7), no jeopardy.
